College Bhawan, Panjab University Candigarh

English 01 10:00 AM
Physical Education 01 12:00 PM

Important Instructions:
1. All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other
relevant documents for verification along with the duly filled form giving
the details at the time of interview.
2. The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at
website (http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php).
3. Candidates are required to bring one set of photocopy of their certificates.
4. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing interview.
